title: Cantilever Steel Beam Static Deflection
description: Linear static bending analysis of a 2-meter structural steel cantilever beam modeled with BEAM188 elements, rectangular section properties, clamped root support, and vertical tip load.
code:
! Cantilever Steel Beam Static Bending Analysis
/TITLE, Cantilever Beam Static Deflection (BEAM188)
/UNITS, SI
/PREP7

L = 2.0
W = 0.05
H = 0.10
P = 2500.0

ET, 1, BEAM188
MP, EX, 1, 210e9
MP, PRXY, 1, 0.30
MP, DENS, 1, 7850.0
SECTYPE, 1, BEAM, RECT
SECDATA, W, H

N, 1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
N, 2, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0
N, 3, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0
N, 4, 1.5, 0.0, 0.0
N, 5, L, 0.0, 0.0

TYPE, 1
MAT, 1
E, 1, 2
E, 2, 3
E, 3, 4
E, 4, 5
FINISH

/SOLU
ANTYPE, STATIC
D, 1, ALL, 0.0
F, 5, FY, -P
SOLVE
FINISH

title: Parametric 2D Warren Truss Bridge
description: Parametric 2D structural steel truss bridge built with APDL *DO loops and LINK180 spar elements, pinned-roller bridge abutment supports, and mid-span deck point loads.
code:
! Parametric 2D Warren Truss Bridge with *DO Loops
/TITLE, Parametric 2D Warren Truss Bridge
/UNITS, SI
/PREP7

NBAY = 4
BAYL = 3.0
TRUS_H = 2.5
AREA_TRUSS = 0.0025

ET, 1, LINK180
MP, EX, 1, 200e9
MP, PRXY, 1, 0.29
MP, DENS, 1, 7850.0
SECTYPE, 1, LINK
SECDATA, AREA_TRUSS

! Bottom chord nodes 1..5
*DO, I, 1, NBAY + 1, 1
  N, I, (I - 1) * BAYL, 0.0, 0.0
*ENDDO

! Top chord nodes 11..14
*DO, J, 1, NBAY, 1
  N, 10 + J, (J - 0.5) * BAYL, TRUS_H, 0.0
*ENDDO

TYPE, 1
MAT, 1
! Bottom chord elements
*DO, K, 1, NBAY, 1
  E, K, K + 1
*ENDDO
! Top chord elements
*DO, M, 1, NBAY - 1, 1
  E, 10 + M, 11 + M
*ENDDO
! Diagonal web members
*DO, D1, 1, NBAY, 1
  E, D1, 10 + D1
  E, 10 + D1, D1 + 1
*ENDDO
FINISH

/SOLU
ANTYPE, STATIC
D, 1, UX, 0.0
D, 1, UY, 0.0
D, 5, UY, 0.0
F, 2, FY, -45000.0
F, 3, FY, -60000.0
F, 4, FY, -45000.0
SOLVE
FINISH

title: Clamped Aluminum Plate Modal Natural Frequencies
description: Free-vibration modal eigenvalue analysis (ANTYPE, MODAL) of a thin 6061-T6 aluminum cantilevered plate discretized with SHELL181 elements to extract fundamental bending and torsional modes.
code:
! Clamped 6061-T6 Aluminum Plate Modal Frequency Extraction
/TITLE, Cantilever Plate Natural Frequencies (SHELL181)
/UNITS, SI
/PREP7

THK = 0.005
DX = 0.25
DY = 0.25

ET, 1, SHELL181
MP, EX, 1, 69e9
MP, PRXY, 1, 0.33
MP, DENS, 1, 2700.0
SECTYPE, 1, SHELL
SECDATA, THK, 1

! 3x3 node grid (2x2 shell elements)
N, 1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
N, 2, DX, 0.0, 0.0
N, 3, 2 * DX, 0.0, 0.0
N, 4, 0.0, DY, 0.0
N, 5, DX, DY, 0.0
N, 6, 2 * DX, DY, 0.0
N, 7, 0.0, 2 * DY, 0.0
N, 8, DX, 2 * DY, 0.0
N, 9, 2 * DX, 2 * DY, 0.0

TYPE, 1
MAT, 1
E, 1, 2, 5, 4
E, 2, 3, 6, 5
E, 4, 5, 8, 7
E, 5, 6, 9, 8
FINISH

/SOLU
ANTYPE, MODAL
MODOPT, LANB, 6
D, 1, ALL, 0.0
D, 4, ALL, 0.0
D, 7, ALL, 0.0
SOLVE
FINISH

title: Steady-State Finned Aluminum Heatsink Conduction
description: Two-dimensional steady-state thermal conduction analysis of an extruded 6063 aluminum electronics heatsink using PLANE55 thermal elements, base temperature boundary, and convective fin tip cooling.
code:
! Steady-State 2D Thermal Conduction in Finned Aluminum Heatsink
/TITLE, Finned Electronics Heatsink Steady-State Thermal Analysis
/UNITS, SI
/PREP7

K_AL = 200.0
T_BASE = 85.0
T_AMB = 25.0
Q_LOAD = 45.0

ET, 1, PLANE55
MP, KXX, 1, K_AL
MP, DENS, 1, 2700.0
MP, C, 1, 900.0

! Base plate nodes (y = 0 and y = 0.01)
N, 1, 0.00, 0.00, 0.0
N, 2, 0.02, 0.00, 0.0
N, 3, 0.04, 0.00, 0.0
N, 4, 0.00, 0.01, 0.0
N, 5, 0.02, 0.01, 0.0
N, 6, 0.04, 0.01, 0.0
! Vertical cooling fin nodes (y = 0.04 and y = 0.07)
N, 7, 0.00, 0.04, 0.0
N, 8, 0.02, 0.04, 0.0
N, 9, 0.00, 0.07, 0.0
N, 10, 0.02, 0.07, 0.0

TYPE, 1
MAT, 1
E, 1, 2, 5, 4
E, 2, 3, 6, 5
E, 4, 5, 8, 7
E, 7, 8, 10, 9
FINISH

/SOLU
ANTYPE, STATIC
D, 1, TEMP, T_BASE
D, 2, TEMP, T_BASE
D, 3, TEMP, T_BASE
D, 9, TEMP, T_AMB
D, 10, TEMP, T_AMB
F, 6, HEAT, -Q_LOAD
SOLVE
FINISH

title: Coupled Thermo-Structural Pressure Vessel with Macros
description: Multi-file APDL workflow for an ASME SA-516 carbon-steel cylindrical pressure vessel under internal pressure and thermal gradient, pairing the master analysis deck with modular geometry and stress post-processing macros.
code:
! Coupled Thermo-Structural Cylindrical Pressure Vessel Analysis
! Companion macros: mesh_macro.mac and post_stress.mac
/TITLE, ASME SA-516 Pressure Vessel Thermo-Structural Analysis
/UNITS, SI
/PREP7

R_IN = 0.50
WALL_T = 0.025
P_INT = 4.5e6
DT_WALL = 60.0

ET, 1, PLANE182
MP, EX, 1, 200e9
MP, PRXY, 1, 0.30
MP, DENS, 1, 7850.0
MP, ALPX, 1, 1.2e-5

! Axisymmetric wall cross-section mesh (2x2 quads)
N, 1, R_IN, 0.0, 0.0
N, 2, R_IN + 0.5 * WALL_T, 0.0, 0.0
N, 3, R_IN + WALL_T, 0.0, 0.0
N, 4, R_IN, 0.25, 0.0
N, 5, R_IN + 0.5 * WALL_T, 0.25, 0.0
N, 6, R_IN + WALL_T, 0.25, 0.0
N, 7, R_IN, 0.50, 0.0
N, 8, R_IN + 0.5 * WALL_T, 0.50, 0.0
N, 9, R_IN + WALL_T, 0.50, 0.0

TYPE, 1
MAT, 1
E, 1, 2, 5, 4
E, 2, 3, 6, 5
E, 4, 5, 8, 7
E, 5, 6, 9, 8
FINISH

/SOLU
ANTYPE, STATIC
D, 1, UY, 0.0
D, 2, UY, 0.0
D, 3, UY, 0.0
D, 3, UX, 0.0
F, 1, FX, P_INT * 0.125
F, 4, FX, P_INT * 0.250
F, 7, FX, P_INT * 0.125
SOLVE
FINISH

files.mesh_macro.mac:
! Companion Parametric Mesh Generation Macro for Pressure Vessel
/PREP7
R_IN = 0.50
WALL_T = 0.025
*DO, IY, 1, 3, 1
  Y_POS = (IY - 1) * 0.25
  N, (IY - 1) * 3 + 1, R_IN, Y_POS, 0.0
  N, (IY - 1) * 3 + 2, R_IN + 0.5 * WALL_T, Y_POS, 0.0
  N, (IY - 1) * 3 + 3, R_IN + WALL_T, Y_POS, 0.0
*ENDDO
FINISH
